title: Unleashing the Unseen: Harnessing Benign Datasets for Jailbreaking Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. The focus is on jailbreaking large language models by creating adversarial suffixes from benign datasets that enforce specific response formats (e.g., poetic style, structured lists).
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on the vulnerabilities of large language models to jailbreaking attacks through adversarial suffixes derived from benign data, rather than on their handling of religious content.
